reviews.text: Lovely groomers. Very clean. Great with our dog who went there for the first time today. He came out perfectly groomed and very happy.
Amazing experience - the team is incredibly kind and warm, making our anxious dog feel very comfortable and happy with his grooming - will be back again!

Such a brilliant experience. I brought my Collie in for grooming and Lauren at Zoomies was incredible. He came out looking gorgeous and clearly enjoyed himself. I won’t be going anywhere else. Thanks, team.
Magic! Bailey usually hates being groomed but he went it and enjoyed every bit of it! Looks and smells amazing 🤩

​Very unprofessional. I gave them a reference photo to follow, but instead, they shaved my dog’s fur down almost completely to the skin without even consulting me first. Now my poor dog will be freezing for the next 3 to 4 months until her coat grows back. I do not recommend this place at all!

We were very happy with the grooming service Zoomies provided for our 1 year old Golden Retriever. She was very nervous but they were very kind and gentle with her. We have already booked her in for her next groom! Thank you!
Amazing service, so easy to book online and they looked after my dog so well. Will certainly be back.
Loved our groom and a lovely staff is always a plus!
My miniature schnauzer was groomed really well. I was so impressed I booked another appointment straight away. The staff at Zoomies were really friendly and helpful too. John

We have just had our 7 year old Wheaton Terrier groomed by Reece. We discussed the length that would work best to get plenty of time between cuts but also still look smart straight away. Reece did a really fantastic job, our dog looks perfect and came out very happy. We are so happy with the job that we have re booked for her winter cut.

As someone who’s new to the area, I was really nervous about where to bring my baby for grooming. Finding someone you trust with your dog is so important, but I honestly couldn’t have been happier with Zoomies Dog Grooming.

When picking her up she looked amazing and so happy. It was obvious she’d been well looked after and was happy throughout her visit.

The team genuinely care about the dogs and treat them so well. I can confidently say I’ve found our new groomer, and we’ll definitely be regulars from now on. Highly recommend!
Thanks a mil Sarah

Couldn’t recommend Zoomies more highly! Great booking app, super efficient, friendly and  responsive. Winnie isn’t the easiest to groomId say, but they handled her brilliantly and did a fantastic job.
Great experience, lovely staff and Louie was delighted with his styling

The guys at Zoomies are great. Roxy had a great groom and has very happy there.
Thanks Niamh and team

Old lady Bowie’s second visit to Zoomies, we followed groomer Reese from her previous location to here. Everyone is super friendly and Reese always listens before start the work. Bowie has multiple health issues, Reese always gives Bow a very enjoyable experience we can see Bow feels super relaxed after the grooming. Previously I have been to other luxury bigger chain grooming place, it’s not the same as here. Definitely worth the travel to give a go❤️

So pleased with our experience with zoomies. Really lovely premises in Stillorgan and great communication from start to finish. The team accommodated our 2 dogs for a full groom at short notice. We have 2 very nervous rescue dogs and they were looked after so well and came out looking beautiful with the cutest bandanas on. Highly recommended and have already booked them back in for their next groom. Many thanks to all the team.

First time getting my dog groomed on Zoomies and such a positive experience! Such friendly and lovely staff and they give
Toby a super groom! Thank you!
Excellent results so attentive to detail, staff extremely friendly and clearly love the dogs they have in their care 100% recommend for grooming  and will deffo be back 🐶🤍 …

Overall, we were not satisfied with our dog’s haircuts. The groomer shaved a chunk out of one of our dog’s head and my partner was not informed of this on collection. She had to go back to get a refund after noticing it in the car (charged full price). I understand accidents happen, but on further examination our dog is also missing chunks of hair on her side that were shaved off.

Our dog is a wire haired dachshund and has only previously been trimmed/clipped, not shaved all over as I believe to be the case here. Quite upsetting as the bald patches are very noticeable and look horrible. They also left cuts under my other dogs under arms, and when contacted they refused a refund, tried to blame the dog, and said it was ‘surface irritation’ Unfortunately I cannot recommend and will not be returning.

Edited to add the ‘small mark’ in question, which is visibly a cut. I would also like to add that their groom happened on the 27th May, and I messaged them informing them of the cut on the 30th May - three days after and not several as mentioned in their response. Their response still reads as a blame game, which I have no interest in playing.
Thanks Ruth ❤️

Today was Teddy’s first grooming appointment, and I couldn’t be happier! He looks absolutely stunning. The team were incredible friendly, professional, and so caring. Highly recommend their services. Thank you for making my boy look so handsome! 🐶🐾✨ …
Fantastic service and very friendly staff. Leo looks super after his visit. Thanks. We will definitely return again.
Had an amazing experience here. My 9 month old KC spaniel’s first ever trip to the groomers and she came back looking perfect! They really listened to what I wanted and did such a fantastic job!
Bailey had her first hair cut at Zoomies and she looked great after. She was delighted with her new 'do', she was nervous going in but came out wagging her tail! Highly recommend!
Fantastic experience for Lexi and us!! She came out different dog and very happy!
Lovely spot for a groom, the girls really looked after my 15 year old King Charles. Place is spotless, would recommend
Thanks for much for the nice review Owen ❤️
Fantastic service, they ladies took amazing care and attention to detail of our little Holly!
Very happy with the excellent professional service in Zoomie kilmacud . This was our second visit and I would highly recommend it. Great staff. Happy dog, happy owner!

Such a wonderful experience from start to finish! My dog Piolho had a full groom and came home looking absolutely gorgeous. What stood out most was how attentive the team was. They listened carefully to what I asked for and executed it exactly right!
They were clearly very gentle and kind with him throughout, and even gave me some great practical tips to take home.
It's rare to find groomers who combine real skill with such warmth.
We'll definitely be back!

1st time bringing our two dogs to Zoomies and I can not recommend them more. Super friendly and kind staff.We had a few bad experiences with other groomers and I explained this to the staff , they were super gentle and caring with our two , in fact the experience was so relaxing that one of our dogs Rocco fell fast asleep while getting groomed. Again I would like to thank all the staff at zombies. Two very happy doggies

Amazing, extremely happy with the service and care.
After having a few bad experiences with other groomers recently I brought Clover to Zoomies. We started with a consultation and the groomer listened carefully to our concerns from past experiences. She also listened extensively to what we wanted.
Clover is a West Highland Terrier and Zoomies gave her the best proper groom that we were looking for.
We are so happy we have booked her again for her next groom.
I would highly recommend them to anybody looking for a Westie cut 💖

We followed Reese, from her last job all the way from Finglas to stillorgan. We know how good she is with Pixie and her attention to detail with grooming is perfection! Zoomies was beautiful and very welcoming, we will definitely be back🥰 …
Dropped fluff ball in for a groom, he came out wagging and looking 2years younger. Lovely new set up in kilmacud easy to book with kind staff.
Very happy with the service. The staff were professional and looked after my dog well.
We had a wonderful experience at Zoomies  & most importantly so did our dog Ted .. he looked so lovely after & the staff were 10/10 .. highly recommend
A great experience with Zoomies this week. Sally was very well cared for and looked fabulously groomed when I picked her up. Tks a mil.

We’ve been using Zoomies for both grooming and daycare for the last few months, and I can’t say enough good things! Our pup Korra gets so excited to go to daycare and they always send photo updates, so we know she’s having a great time.
We’ve also been very happy with the grooms. Both times the groomer has explained any areas of concern pre-groom and we have loved both the communication and the results!
So glad I found Zoomies! Incredibly friendly and warm staff. Great to get updates on daycare during the day and I can tell my normally pretty timid dog loves coming by how she bounds in each time.
Great puppy package! Puppy came out fresh and happy, with a cute little bandana
Dobby loved his grooming and all the attention he got from the staff at Zoomies. Highly recommended!
Thanks so much Madalina

Rosie our very nervous dog was so happy in Zoomies & treated with such care & kindness. The time taken to talk about Rosie & make sure she was happy… was 10/10…All the staff are so so nice & Rosie looked beautiful after her grooming. 💞 she will be back very soon. …
Very pleasant staff, our dog looks great
I’m very happy with the grooming, my dog Gatto looks amazing and was treated with such care. Highly recommend!
Thanks Amy

We visited zoomies this afternoon with our 2.5 yo golden retriever Winnie , after a lovely welcome  Winnie had the best groom to date , she was so happy and her cut is perfect  , absolutely delighted, thank you Niamh & Co . We will be back !
Wonderful service, fantastic team, loved the whole experience. We definitely will be back ☺️☺️☺️

I left another groomers because I was not happy with the service. Honestly the best decision.  Zoomies are total pros and my senior doggie had the best groom of her life. She is a nervous doggie and not a fan of being groomed. Katelyn did an incredible job and managed to trim all her nails. No groomer has ever achieved this. Don’t look any further Zoomies are first class. Thank you Katelyn and team Zoomies xxx
Lovely friendly salon for pets
I wouldn’t use anywhere else. I have two old English sheepdogs so not the easiest but the staff are amazing. I’m so happy I found them. See before (she got into my colour bomb) and after.

Took my Labrador in for a full de-shedding treatment and I couldn’t be happier! The staff was incredibly friendly, and Kiki looks and smells amazing. I think we left an entire second dog's worth of fur behind. Highly recommend
Niamh and the team provided a great service for our two dogs grooming - highly recommended!
Amazing staff, made Bailey feel right at home as he’s nervous getting a cut! Booked in again🫶 …
Thanks so much Marita
Probably our 12 year old cocker spaniel’s best groom. Very tidy!
Highly recommend Zoomies. The team are very friendly and took great care of my two geriatric yorkies. Thank you ☺️

This is my first time bringing my dog to this company for grooming. Since Reese has always been my dog’s groomer, I followed her here. I’m also very impressed by how warm and kind all the staff are—they made a great first impression!
First time bringing Benji to get groomed. Amazing experience. Friendly and lovely team. Highly recommended to all .. A+ dog grooming service!!!
Lovely staff, great care, listened to instructions and was extremely satisfied. Thought it was a little pricey, but maybe I’m out of touch… overall very happy though..

Lovely new shop. Staff are very helpful and accommodating and knowledgeable. They fitted us in at a good time to suit my
anxious dog. My dogs got a lovely much needed groom. Thanks
Our dog is usually very nervous but had a great experience. Will return and would recommend!
Wonderful new groomers with such a welcoming and warm atmosphere. Bonnie was brilliant with our dog, will definitely be back!
A great job !  Rambo looks amazing love the way you shaped the hair on his head

First groom here for our 13 year old Annie.
Have to say best consultation and review we've ever received. Annie looks great. REESE is special 💕 (hope I spelt your name right) …

Brought my Shiba inu in for grooming yesterday and I couldn't be happier with the service.
The team were so kind and patient, and my dog looks amazing.
You can really tell they care about the dogs they work with.
So happy to have such a great groomer locally.
I will be using this service from now on.
I highly recommend.

My dog Casper has been to Zoomies twice-once for grooming and once for day care. Both times he had a great time and was cared for very well. Everybody there was so welcoming and kind. He will definitely be going back 😊 …
Professional and very good customer service. Highly recommend
I was very pleased with my pup’s first groom at Zoomies. Lovely staff and great to see a new business in the area.
From the moment I walked in the whole staff were there to greet chewie done an amazing job thanks guys I’ll be back

We had a great experience at Zoomies for our pup’s first visit there. The team was friendly, welcoming and clearly very comfortable working with dogs.

One thing we especially liked was the chart they showed us with the different coat lengths and how your dog would look depending on the option you choose. It made it really easy to understand the choices and decide what would work best.

Our pup came back looking fantastic, clean, neatly trimmed and very happy. We’ll definitely be coming back to Zoomies again!

Visited Zoomies to get our two Minature Schnauzers groomed. Had spoken to Lauren before our visit to express our requirements.  She was amazing! We brought the dogs in and the results were stunning.  It was our pups first ever groom and she came out transformed.  10/10 for the whole experience and would highly recommend Zoomies to everyone looking to get their dog groomed!
Great service! My dog looked great after her groom and seemed very happy with the staff, who were lovely. Will be returning for her next groom!
My dog loved being groomed and came home extra soft and fluffy and smelled amazing!
Delighted with how Bella looked after her groom - lovely team of very caring animal lovers !

Lola LOVES going to Zoomies for daycare. She loves all the girls who spoil her and of course her new doggy friends - especially Nigel. She had a mini groom and looks and smells amazing. Great to know your special dog is being minded by people who love her.

One of the best grooms Louies ever had. The staff are all lovely and so friendly. The groom is perfect couldn’t ask for a better service. Will definetly be returning.

Very impressed. See you soon
Lauren and Louie

Amazing experience, first time bringing my dog to get groomed as he’s a wire haired vizsla and I found it extremely hard to find a groomer. Collaege told me about Lauren in Zoomies and I booked my dog in straight away. The moment we walked in to the moment we collected him, was a lovely experience and I could see he had a lovely time while he was there.
Lauren did an exceptional job on him and I wouldn’t go to anyone else now. Thanks guys 🙌🏻
Excellent grooming service, my first time here and I will definitely be back .
Bonnie is an excellent groomer, service was excellent and highly recommend for your pet.

Bonnie was absolutely incredible. She was so patient and good with Molly, who came back out to me after her groom delighted and gorgeous! I would absolute recommend Bonnie as a groomer and Zoomies as a whole. Will be back fo sure ⭐⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I cannot recommend highly enough, Lauren is fantastic with the dogs and does a beautiful trim. All the groomers are lovely’ my dogs are happy and I’m delighted 5 🌟 …

I visited Zoomies today with my foster dog Boris, who needed pretty much ‘the works’. The experience from the first email I sent, to Boris happily trotting out beautifully groomed complete with a very cute bandana, was just perfect. Lauren, Boris’s groomer and Bonnie were so kind, friendly and complimentary-it really was a 5 star experience. I would highly recommend this service 😊

Milo had his first grooming today with Lauren from zoomies. Have him booked in for his next visits. girls were so lovely and Milo looks fabulous I can’t thank them enough ,thank you Lauren and Bonnie .xx

Wonderful experience at Zoomies. The staff are friendly, patient, and genuinely cares for dogs. My dog came out looking amazing, smelling great, and happy—not stressed at all. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend them! 🐾 …
Frankie had the best time at zoomies, brilliant facility, great groom and top class team. Looking forward to our next visit
Thank you for looking after Rua so well, she is a nervous dog and refused to go into a groomers previously but she was taken care of. Very nice staff.

Amazing experience at Zoomies today top quality groom and the staff were excellent. Would highly recommend!!

Our Cavapoo Alfie is anxious when getting groomed so can be hard work. The girls were really patient and made him feel at ease.
